_readme: WHAT THIS FILE IS: the rule book. Each entry says: when this group exists in IAM Identity Center, create this permission set and assign it to the group.

HOW TO ADD A GROUP: copy an entry, change 'group' (it must match the Identity Center group name exactly, capitals included), choose a permission set 'name' (at most 32 characters) and list the AWS managed policies.

RULES: one group per permission set. Every policy must be listed in policy-allowlist.json. A policy marked privileged there needs a written 'justification' in the entry, and a session no longer than its limit.
watch_group_prefix: a group whose name starts with this text but has no entry below raises a warning, so a typo does not go unnoticed.
HOW TO CHANGE IT: edit on a branch and open a pull request. Merging to main deploys it after your approval.
This file is plain JSON, which does not allow comments, so these notes live in the _readme key. The program ignores it.

permission_set.name: Henz-IT-ReadOnly
permission_set.description: Read-only access for IT staff. Managed by the henz-iga automation; do not edit by hand.

permission_set.name: Henz-IT-PowerUsers
permission_set.description: Power user access for IT engineers. Managed by the henz-iga automation; do not edit by hand.
permission_set.justification: IT engineers build and run workloads in the lab account. No IAM management.

permission_set.name: Henz-IT-Security
permission_set.description: Security audit access for the security team. Managed by the henz-iga automation; do not edit by hand.

permission_set.name: Henz-IT-Admins
permission_set.description: Administrator access for the IT admin group. Managed by the henz-iga automation; do not edit by hand.
permission_set.justification: Break-glass and platform administration of the lab workload account, used by the sole engineer. One hour sessions only.
